blurb: Memory Lanes is a restaurant and bowling center where guests can bowl and enjoy homemade food. They host private reservations and children's birthday parties by email inquiry only. The venue is 21+ after 10pm.
extraNote: Private reservations and children’s birthday party inquiries handled only through email communication with event coordinator · Event coordinating office hours 9am-4:30pm Mon-Fri except holidays; emails responded within 24 hours · Call ahead to check bowling availability due to occasional events or parties
